grade: 七年级下 ~ 八年级上
summary: 表示将来要发生的动作或状态：will + 动词原形，或 be going to + 动词原形。

rules.title: will + 动词原形
rules.detail: 所有人称都用 will，没有人称和数的变化。否定 will not = won't；疑问把 will 提前。常与 tomorrow, next week, in the future, in + 时间段 连用。

examples.en: I will visit Beijing next month.

examples.zh: 机器人不会完全取代老师。

examples.en: Will it rain tomorrow? — Yes, it will.

rules.title: be going to + 动词原形：计划、打算，或看迹象将要发生
rules.detail: 表示事先计划好的事（I'm going to study abroad）或有迹象表明要发生（Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.）。be 随主语变化。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this Sunday.
examples.zh: 这周日我们打算去野餐。

examples.en: Look at the black clouds! It is going to rain.

rules.title: There will be：there be 句型的将来时
rules.detail: 「将来会有……」用 There will be...，不分单复数。

examples.en: There will be more trees in our city in ten years.
examples.zh: 十年后我们城市会有更多树木。

pitfalls: will 后动词加变化：❌ She will comes. → ✓ She will come.
be going to 漏 be：❌ I going to swim. → ✓ I am going to swim.
next week 前加介词：❌ I'll go next the week. → ✓ I'll go next week.

questions.stem: There ___ a sports meeting in our school next week.
questions.explain: there be 的将来时是 There will be，不能说 there will have。

questions.stem: Look at the sky! It ___ rain soon.
questions.explain: 有迹象表明将要发生（乌云密布），用 be going to。

questions.stem: — Will you come to my birthday party? — ___.
questions.explain: Will 开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答 Yes, I will。

questions.stem: I think people ___ more free time in the future.
questions.explain: in the future 提示将来时，will + 动词原形。

questions.stem: They ___ (move) to a new house next month. （已计划好的事，用 be going to）
questions.explain: 主语 they → are going to move，表示计划好的安排。

questions.stem: Don't worry! I ___ (help) you with your English.
questions.explain: 临时决定或承诺帮对方，用 will help。

questions.stem: She will goes to Shanghai with her parents tomorrow.
questions.explain: will 后动词用原形 go。

questions.stem: 明天天气将会晴朗。（翻译整句）
answer: the weather will be sunny tomorrow.
questions.explain: will + be + 形容词；the weather 或 it 作主语均可。

questions.stem: 我打算今晚上完成作业。（翻译整句）
answer: i am going to finish my homework tonight.
i'm going to finish my homework tonight.
questions.explain: be going to + 动词原形表示打算；主语 I 用 am。
